jurisdiction: General assessment; used in Nebraska PAD ratio context
summary: Ratio-study uniformity statistic measuring average percentage dispersion of ratios around the median ratio.
plain_language: COD shows how tightly individual assessment ratios cluster around the typical ratio. Lower usually means more uniform within the tested group.

thresholds.note: IAAO Ratio Study Standard gives COD ranges by property type and market homogeneity.

relationships.note: COD is a common horizontal equity statistic.
COD is centered on median ratio.
PRD addresses vertical equity signals rather than general dispersion.

source_refs.citation: IAAO, Glossary for Property Appraisal and Assessment.
